name: Pecheur des Courants
description: Courantiste manipulant les flux liquides pour piéger et ralentir les unités ennemies dans les environnements aquatiques.

subject.archetype: Pecheur des Courants — Exode pélagique Uncommon class longue_portee

loadout.armor_outfit: Organic coral armor grown from living reef material with bioluminescent combat indicators pulsing in rapid rhythm, hydrodynamic fins extending from arms and calves streaming in current, translucent membranes trailing from shoulders
loadout.arsenal: Bioluminescent harpoon cannon with living coral barrel pulsing with each discharge, hydro-kinetic gauntlets channeling water into pressurized cutting jets visible as focused force streams The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting all_enemy, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Both arms sweeping outward in devastating horizontal arc with focused targeted wave of negation energy expanding in all directions like dark tsunami rushing across battlefield toward all enemies
attitude.emotion: Battle-tested confidence — knowing skills will carry through the engagement

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Abyssal Deep Blue
palette_names.role: primary_accent — skin tones and surrounding water mass

palette_names.name: Bioluminescent Cyan
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — ability effects and natural body glow

palette_names.name: Foam White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — spray splashes and bubble highlights

color_and_light.lighting_setup: oxidized copper frame with faction insignia embossed on each corner, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Slightly low angle waist-up shot with environmental action visible in background, motion blur on debris and effects

scenography.setting: Storm-ravaged aquatic colonial battlefield with massive waves crashing over organic structures sending debris flying, lightning illuminating in stark flashes, allied forces pushed back while bioluminescent defensive flares light the water column with cyan bursts
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Massive dark ripple of suppression moving across battlefield at high speed, each enemy hit visibly weakening and dimming as power is drained simultaneously, Everything the wave touches deteriorates — surfaces cracking and crumbling, colors draining to gray, structural integrity failing, zone of death spreading across battlefield leaving devastation, Massive waves crashing and spraying bioluminescent droplets everywhere, water vortex spiraling around character pulling debris, glowing fish scattering in panic, bubbles erupting from seabed, electrical arcs flashing through charged seawater
